title: C Position: Right Hand (C D E F G)
description: The five-finger C position for the right hand: thumb on middle C, one finger per key up to G, so that every note has its own finger and the hand never moves.

arrangements.label: Beginner
arrangements.notes: Stepwise and small-skip patterns within C4-G4, every note fingered 1-5 so the hand stays fixed over the five keys; the left hand rests.
teachingPoints: Place the right thumb on middle C and let fingers 2-5 fall naturally on D, E, F and G; do not look down once they are placed.
Bars 1-2 walk up and back down; bars 3-4 introduce skips (C-E, D-F) - keep the unused fingers resting lightly on their keys.
Bar 6 repeats G three times with finger 5: play from the knuckle, not by flopping the hand.
Hold the half notes in bars 4 and 6 and the final whole note for their full value.
